old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because the Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD. IPMI section 22.1 nevertheless defines mandatory App command 0x2E, its one-byte mask, standard bits, OEM-preservation requirement, unsupported-feature behavior and completion response; paired Get 0x2F supplies authoritative readback. The exact standard-bit target vector is a Project policy choice that can be parameterized without editing protected source.
disposition_reason: Create a Review-layer standards-based case while preserving the Master TBD history. Read current mask with 0x06/0x2F, preserve OEM bits 7:5 verbatim and reserved bit 4 as zero, change only one Project-approved standard bit among SEL logging, Event Message Buffer, buffer-full interrupt and receive-message/KCS interrupt, then require completion and exact 0x2F readback before restoring baseline. Use an explicit per-bit support/coverage matrix; never guess or alter OEM bits, disable required monitoring without approval, clear logs or generate events as a shortcut.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1003, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1004 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1004 / variant 473bef4f089d38ff.
IPMI v2.0 section 22.1 makes Set BMC Global Enables a mandatory App command 0x2E with one request byte and completion-only response; section 22.2 defines Get 0x2F with the same one-byte state map.

Bits 3:0 have standard meanings: SEL logging, Event Message Buffer, its full interrupt and receive-message/KCS interrupt. Bit 4 is reserved. OEM bits 7:5 must not be altered by generic software, so a read-modify-write preserves them unless an OEM specification and separate approval exist.

Unsupported buffer/interrupt enable may return CCh, or the BMC may accept the request but return the corresponding bit as zero. This supplies deterministic supported/unsupported handling instead of requiring guessed OEM behavior.

ED-03, ED-06, ED-13, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-28 and ED-30 permit a standard parameterized draft with approval/evidence/recovery; ED-33 through ED-38 preserve TBD history while prohibiting OEM guesses, read-only substitution and retries.

test_case.test_name: Set and restore approved standard BMC Global Enables with OEM-preserving read-modify-write
test_case.purpose: Verify each Project-required standard Global Enable bit can be set to its approved state and read back without altering OEM/reserved bits, losing required event/message visibility or leaving the BMC outside its captured baseline.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/interface identity, pinned IPMI firmware/tool/parser and protected App 0x2E/0x2F raw runner

Versioned Project coverage matrix for standard bits 3 SEL logging, 2 Event Message Buffer, 1 buffer-full interrupt and 0 receive-message/KCS interrupt, including supported state, target value, expected CCh/zero behavior and SPEC-backed N/A
Complete 0x2F baseline plus OEM-bit preservation policy; OEM bits 7:5 may change only with exact vendor semantics and separate approval, while reserved bit 4 is always zero
SEL/event/message/KCS health observers, independent OOB management path, monitoring-owner approval, maintenance window and per-bit dwell/readback/restore bounds
Exact baseline restore mask, protected workload/message queues, evidence preservation and an incident runbook for lost interrupt/message/log behavior
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID MATRIX PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact target and preserve SEL/event/message/audit evidence. Read `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x2f`, require one well-formed mask byte, decode all bits and capture monitoring/KCS baseline. Select one approved standard bit from the versioned coverage matrix; construct a read-modify-write mask that preserves OEM bits 7:5 and all other non-target standard bits and forces reserved bit 4 to zero. After immediate approval send exactly one `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x2e <mask>`, require completion-only success, then read 0x2F and require the target state plus unchanged non-target/OEM bits. Treat CCh or accepted-but-zero according to the standard and platform support record, never as PASS for enable coverage. Observe passive SEL/message/KCS health without clearing logs or generating destructive events. Restore the exact baseline mask under approval, read back and verify health. Repeat only as separate approved matrix entries, never as an automatic sweep or retry.
test_case.expected_result: For each applicable standard-bit matrix entry, one approved Set completes, Get 0x2F reports the requested supported target bit, all non-target/OEM bits remain unchanged, reserved bit is zero and required SEL/event/message/KCS behavior stays healthy. Unsupported optional functions are recorded from CCh/zero readback and are N/A only with platform SPEC evidence. Final mask and monitoring health exactly match baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is per bit and aggregate: exact target/approval, source-traced standard command, OEM-preserving one-bit RMW, completion 00, exact 0x2F readback, stable monitoring and baseline restoration are mandatory. TBD alone, command success, bulk mask writes, OEM/reserved changes, disabled required SEL logging, accepted-but-zero unsupported bit, missing supported-bit coverage, unproven N/A, lost KCS/message service or failed restore cannot pass. Missing Project target vector is NOT READY rather than Pending.
safety_gate: Require monitoring-owner and point-of-action confirmation for each bit or explicitly bounded batch after showing current/target mask, diff, support evidence and restoration path.
Always read-modify-write. Preserve OEM bits 7:5 exactly and set reserved bit 4 to zero; never infer OEM semantics from the title or adjacent cases.
Do not disable SEL logging, Event Message Buffer or communication interrupts required by the active environment unless the exact short-lived transition and independent visibility are approved.
Preserve logs and passive message/event evidence; do not clear SEL or manufacture watchdog/RAS events to prove behavior in this case.
Use an independent OOB path because bit 0 can affect KCS interrupts and other bits affect local message visibility; stop on loss, flood or monitoring drift.
No automatic retry, bulk bit sweep or compensating reset/power action. Any failed restoration uses the separately approved incident procedure.
expected_evidence: Master TBD snapshot, applicable IPMI rule, Project bit-matrix revision, target identity and firmware/tool/parser versions
Pre-state raw 0x2F byte, decoded standard/OEM/reserved bits and SEL/event/message/KCS health baseline
Per-bit approval, exact RMW calculation, raw 0x2E request/completion and raw 0x2F field-by-field readback
Unsupported CCh/zero behavior and platform SPEC/N/A evidence where applicable; passive monitoring timeline
Restored baseline mask/health, OEM preservation, no-clear/no-event-injection/no-retry audit and independent verdict
test_case.recovery: On completion/readback mismatch, OEM/reserved drift or monitoring/KCS degradation, stop without retry or reset and retain all evidence. Through the independent OOB path, only the owner may authorize the pre-reviewed baseline RMW restore; verify 0x2F plus monitoring health. If restore fails, follow the BMC/monitoring incident runbook rather than improvising log clear, power cycle or firmware action.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 22.1/22.2, Tables 22-2/22-3 and Appendix G define mandatory App 0x2E/0x2F, the one-byte masks, OEM-preserving RMW, standard bits and unsupported CCh/zero-readback behavior.

project_authority: The Project monitoring/BMC owner chooses the required standard-bit matrix, support expectations and allowed transitions and approves each execution. OEM/System Integrator authority alone may define OEM bits; absent that, they are preserved exactly and are not silently marked tested.
